explanation: Sort names by first name and then last name. The equality test compares only first names, so unique compacts each first-name group to its first sorted representative before erasing the suffix.
timeComplexity: O(n log(n+1)) name comparisons; comparison costs depend on name lengths.
spaceComplexity: O(log(n+1)) sorting stack space; the supplied vector is modified.
